about: Gameplay potential of the second 100 ideas, on the same scale as ratings-1.json: combat, enemies, setpieces, systems, lives, 1-5 each.

last-train-east: Car-by-car gauntlet, darkness as a rule; a train is a narrow map for many lives
precinct-zero: Siege with prisoners as allies; power, fire, the van
mall-of-the-dead: Clear, fortify, then raiders break it: two phases of enemy
night-shift-infection: Hospital as a dungeon; sedatives and UV as counters; a cordon outside
salt-island: Salt water as the rule; boats as the key; day and night
the-crazies-county: Infected and the army both hostile; a county to cross
frost-bitten: Cold slows them, fire speeds them: a two-edged counter
the-hive-city: Hive builds walls; EMP and fire; a core to destroy
the-carnival-dead: Music as a lure; a pier to burn
the-valley-below: Vibration rule and rooftops: a playground of a map
outpost-nine: Brood ladder on a base in a sandstorm, heat-vision rule
under-the-city: Sound-hunting crawlers in drains; flooding as a weapon
hot-summer-hunter: Gangs and feds plus an apex hunter with a code
the-fog-market: Five creature types and a cult inside; light draws some, darkness others
the-silent-valley: Noise rule makes every action a choice
slick: Kill the host and the rest die: a clear goal
roadhouse-siege: Breeders eat their wounded; light as a weapon
fourth-of-july-beach: One apex; the hunt at sea is the payoff
spider-town: Four spider types with distinct behaviours and a queen
swarm-season: A swarm needs systems more than fights
rat-tower: A tower climbed against a swarm
crawl-space-snakes: Cold as a counter in a hot dome
the-estate: A tower block siege by alien beasts; fireworks
under-the-shield: Troopers, heavies, drones, fighters, a shield: full war
harvest-machines: Water as the weakness; walkers to stalk
dark-glasses: Glasses reveal enemies: a strong mechanic
beachhead: Squad combat, walkers, a node to paint
prison-transport: Possessed neighbours plus convicts plus hunters
the-cloud: Don't look: a great rule, little fighting
occupied-city: Stealth and resistance cells across a city: built for many lives
crash-site: Aliens and the army in a logging town
dock-mech: Ground crew keeping a mech alive
skull-island-village: Walled village, a dozen creatures, an ape ally
district-patrol: Gangs, mercs, bots and an enforcement mech
tower-christmas: The best one-building action design; few lives fit it
the-block-raid: A tower raid floor by floor
home-turf: A gauntlet through gang turfs, each with its own style
polar-night: A month of night; UV and fire; a town under siege: top tier
ghost-trappers: Ghost-catching as a verb; a city of hauntings
faire-dead: Skeleton army with archers and knights; medieval weapons
prom-mouth: School full of demons and vampires
behind-lines: Squad, stealth, a lab of super-soldiers
outpost-bunker: Power switches ghosts on and off
lawless-night: A city of hostile factions for a night
zoo-storm: Five animal types loose in a flooded city
mischief-night: Rules: light kills them, water multiplies them
vault-of-the-dead: Heist through a zombie city with smart alphas
